other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Goa and have lived there for at least 15 years.
Must be listed in the voters' list and possess a permanent ration card.
Income must be less than ₹1,50,000 per annum, except retired state government employees who are exempt.
Must require a medical facility not available in Government Hospitals of Goa (except NICU, ventilatory support, and kidney dialysis where any empanelled hospital can be chosen).

Must be suffering from a sickness requiring one of the listed super‑specialty treatments (CAPD, dialysis, plastic surgery, ICU, NICU, PICU, trauma care, CABG/PTCA, open heart surgery, kidney transplantation, neurosurgery, radiotherapy/chemotherapy, cochlear implant, spastic child, cerebral palsy, skeletal deformities, bone marrow transplant).
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance for a range of super‑specialty treatments with ceiling limits from ₹15,000 per month up to ₹8,00,000 per treatment.
